THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A PURCHASE ORDER WITHOUT PROVIDING FOR FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION OR A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. 

DoDEA intends to award a Firm Fixed Price purchase order to Robin Merger Corporation, UEI D6DEV2PFNJ67 to obtain ISTE membership to provide DoDEA educators access to high-quality professional learning and resources that support both professional growth and classroom practice. 

Please see the attached notice.
